MacSystemIntegrityProtectionConfiguratio.description: The System Integrity Protection (SIP) configuration for a SIP modification task.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

schema.description: Resource schema for an EC2 Mac modification task. A Mac modification task records a System Integrity Protection (SIP) configuration change or an Amazon EBS root volume ownership delegation applied to an Amazon EC2 Mac instance. This is a read-only resource: the service provides no API to update, cancel or delete a task.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Mac modification task.

InstanceId.description: The ID of the Amazon EC2 Mac instance that the task was created for.

MacModificationTaskId.description: The ID of the Mac modification task.

StartTime.description: The date and time the task was created, in the UTC time zone.

Tags.description: The tags assigned to the task.
